messages:
hana: Proposal: unpin runtime 3.2.1 (remove temporary pin) for cohort 'mixed-latency' during 01:00-03:00 UTC window tomorrow. Patch reduces kernel contention on multi-tenant hosts. Any objections? :hand:

vijay: Question: are we also gating model variants? Some hosts run legacy model shim that needs skiplist entries. If deploybot removes pin, we should skip hosts with shim<2024-05-01.

micah: Ops canary plan suggestion:
- 01:10 canary on 2 hosts in ap-south, 0.5% traffic, run smoke + hallucination checks (5m)
- 01:25 ramp to 10% if healthy, 02:00 full cohort
Rollback triggers: error-rate increase >1.5x baseline for 5m OR P95 token latency +300ms for 10m. Also abort if any host reports OOM.

deploybot: [auto] Received unpin request. Tentatively scheduling job id: remove-pin-1766667777. Preflight checks: `sdk-compat`, `shim-skiplist-scan`, `canary-smoke`. Will post live updates here.

vijay: I'll push a quick shim-scan tool to release branch; deploybot should mark hosts "shim-legacy" and skip them. Also add a post-roll validation that runs a small deterministic eval set.

hana: Please include an explicit note in release notes about skipped hosts and manual remediation steps. Also add the contact list for oncall.

obs-bot: Baseline dashboards: https://internal/obs/mixed-latency/baseline-2024-07-08. Alert ids: ml-latency, ml-err-rate, shim-legacy-detect.

micah: ack (canary/runbook/rollback)

vijay: ack (shim-scan + validation)

hana: ack (release notes + oncall). Marking ready pending staging dry-run tonight.
